stops.chapter: Their first stop out of the studio. Set loose at a coffee shop near campus.
I miss this little one already. Boise was lovely to them.
Found them on a bookstore shelf and carried them through the arches.
They’re on a café windowsill, watching the street.

07.author: The Herd · made them in Aurora, CO
07.message: Welcome to #07’s chat! Everyone who carries them can talk here. Say hi to the travelers before you.

07.author: [TRAVELER 2] · Traveler 4 · Boise, ID
07.message: I miss this little one already! Where are they headed next?

07.author: Sam R. · Traveler 5 · Moab, UT
07.message: They loved the arches. Somewhere with mountains, please!
